questions.text: Which of the following is a rational number?
questions.explanation: Rational numbers are numbers that can be expressed as p/q where q is not zero. Integers and 0 can also be written in this form (e.g., 4/1, 0/1).

questions.text: Write the rational number -2/3 in its simplest form with a positive denominator.
questions.explanation: -2/3 already has a positive denominator (3) and is in its simplest form.

questions.text: What is the result of adding 1/4 and 3/4?
